translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yaak'oobi Eesaanna Gaketteedda
Yaak'oobi d'ok'k'u gi s'eelliide, Eesay bare oyddu s'eetu asaana yiyaawaa be'eedda. Hewaa diraw naanaa Liyiw, Raaheeliwunne laa"u k'oomatuwaakko shaakkeedda.
K'oomatuwaanne unttunttu naanaa sintsan, Liyonne I naanaa unttunttu geeduwaan, Raaheelonne Yooseefa wurssetsan wotseedda.
Shin I bare huup'iyaw sintsaw aad'd'iide, bare ishaakko matiidde, sa'aa gakki gakkiide laappun kaala goynneedda.
Shin Eesay aanana gaketanaw wos's'iide, Aa k'ood'iyaa k'oommi yereedda. Unttunttu yeekkeeddino.

Yaatina Eesay d'ok'k'u gi s'eelliide, machatuwaanne naanaa be'eedda; I, «Ha neenana de'iyaawanttu oonee?» yaagiide oochcheedda. Yaak'oobi, «Unttunttu S'oossay ne k'oomaw keekatetsaan immeedda naanaa» yaageedda.
K'oomatuu barenttu naanatuwaanna shiik'iide goynneeddinno.
Hewaappe guyye, Liyanne izi naanay yiide goynneeddinno; wurssetsaan Yooseefonne Raaheela yiide goynneeddinno.
Eesay, «Ha sintsan taananna gaketeedda wudii ubbay k'ay ayee?» yaagiide oochcheedda. I, «Ta godaw, hewe taani ne sintsaan nashettanaassa» yaageedda.
Shin Eesay, «Ta ishaw, taw darobay de'ee; newe neessa gido» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi, «Tuytti, ha"i taani ne sintsaan nashshetteedawaa gidooppe, ha taani immiyaawaa taappe akka. Neeni taana mokka akkeedda diraw, taani ne deemuwaa be'iyaawe S'oossaa deemuwaa be'iyaawaa mala.
Taani new aheedda ha imuwaa akka; ayaw gooppe, S'oossay keekiidde immina, taw besseedda» yaageedda. Yaak'oobi shoobiyaa toleedda diraw, Eesay hewaa akkeedda.
Hewaappe guyye Eesay, «Ane dendda; nu ogiyaa boytte; taani neenana ittippe baana» yaageedda.

Shin Yaak'oobi Aa, «Ta godaw, naanay shuga gidiyaawaa eraasa; k'ay taani barenttu galo maratuwaa d'antsiyaa dorssatuwaanne miizzaa naagana koshshee; Asay unttunttu itti gallassaa dirbbissi laaggooppe, mehiyaa ubbay hayk'k'ana.
Hewaa diraw, ta godaw, ne k'oomaappe sintsataade ba; taani Se'iiran ta godaa gakkanaw, ta sintsaan de'iyaa mehiyaa hemetaa keenaanne naanaa hemetaa keenaa loddan kaallana» yaageedda.
Eesay Aa, «Yaatooppe taani ta asaappe amareedawaa new ashshay» yaageedda. Shin Yaak'oobi Aa, «Hewe ayissee? Taani ta godaa sintsaan nashshettiyaawe taw gidana» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Eesay he gallassi ogiyaan geliide, Se'iira simmeedda.
Shin Yaak'oobi Sukkoota beedda; yan barew golliyaa kees's'eedda; bare mehetookka daasiyaa daaseedda. Hewaa diraw he sa'aa Sukkoota
giide suntseedda.
Yaak'oobi Masp'p'es'oomiyaappe simmeedda wode, Kanaane biittan de'iyaa Sekeeme giyaa katamaa sarotetsaan gakkeedda; I he katamaw bazzuwaan utteedda.
Bare dunkkaaniyaa d'ogeedda gadiyaa Shekeema aawuwaa Hamoora naanatuwaappe s'eetu s'agaraa biran shammeedda.
Yan yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'iide Aa, «S'oossaa, Israa'eeliyaa S'oossaa» giide suntseedda.

footnotes.text: Sukkoota: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Daasiyaa» giyaawaa.
